# Latin pair bridge fixtures

These lossless PNGs preserve the original RGB pixels from the known development
cases recorded in the d711eec evidence chain. They are existing observations,
not new font renders or independent holdout examples.

provenance.json records the original dimensions, RGB hashes, source case IDs,
model references and fixture PNG hashes. JPEG cases retain their decoded JPEG
pixels, including the thickened XY contact and overlapping Gothic glyph boxes.
No glyph pixels were removed, interpolated or added.
